weeks.title: Week 1: Deferred Tax Basics
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 1: Deferred Tax Basics

Learning Objectives

  • Identify temporary vs. permanent differences
  • Calculate deferred tax assets and liabilities
  • Adjust deferred balances for enacted rate changes

Key Topics

1. Temporary differences

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Temporary differences. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Temporary differences concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Temporary differences is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

2. DTA and DTL calculation

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to DTA and DTL calculation. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply DTA and DTL calculation concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.

CPA Exam Tip: Tax rate changes is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

Practice Application

Work through practice problems applying week 1: deferred tax basics concepts. These problems mirror actual CPA exam scenarios and real-world CFO challenges.

Key Takeaways

  • Master Temporary differences for exam success and professional competence
  • Master DTA and DTL calculation for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Tax rate changes for exam success and professional competence
  • Understand authoritative guidance and when to apply it
  • Practice computational problems until you can solve them efficiently
  • Connect concepts to real-world CFO responsibilities

weeks.title: Week 4: Business Combinations & Intraperiod Allocation
weeks.lessonHtml:
